basis: 2026-10-15 review of BROWSER_SELF_DENIAL records. The register premise for GHSA-vhrc-hgrq-x75r (@tiptap/extension-link javascript: URL XSS) was 'cross-user exploitation requires server persistence which sanitize_html strips'. Frappe 988e54f3 sanitize_html returns input unchanged when is_json(value) is true, so a stored JSON-quoted HTML value bypasses the sanitizer. The premise is invalid and the closure is withdrawn to BLOCKED. Containment: apps/foundation_security/foundation_security/html_containment.py (unit-verified only; runtime verification pending). Also dispositions GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr (esbuild, Deno module, withdrawn 2026-06-17) and GHSA-8p5q-j9m2-g8wr (lodash, withdrawn 2021-10-01) as BUILD_ONLY. Both were undispositioned in the register. Neither is returned by the npm bulk endpoint for the installed versions on 2026-10-15.

advisories.summary: Withdrawn Advisory: esbuild: Missing binary integrity verification in Deno module enables remote code execution via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: GitHub marks GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr withdrawn (withdrawn_at 2026-06-17T13:42:24Z), so it is not an active advisory. Its scope is the esbuild Deno module, which the npm install path never ships. esbuild in the pinned trees is a build-time tool (vite and the frontend build), not a runtime component. The npm bulk endpoint on 2026-10-15 did not return this id for the installed esbuild versions (0.21.5, 0.14.54).
advisories.fix_path: No action for the shipped trees. If the advisory is reinstated, upgrading esbuild to >= 0.28.1 is the fix, and the build-tool path would be re-triaged.

advisories.summary: Withdrawn: Arbitrary code execution in lodash (CVE-2021-41720)
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: GitHub marks GHSA-8p5q-j9m2-g8wr withdrawn (withdrawn_at 2021-10-01T22:04:28Z), so it is not an active advisory. The CommonJS lodash in the trees is used only by build tooling (postcss, svgo, tailwind helpers) and is not bundled into the desk or SPA runtime. The desk runtime uses lodash-es, and a grep of shipped frappe, erpnext, education, and hrms sources finds no _.template call (the only template call is Leaflet's L.Util.template in a vendored control). The npm bulk endpoint on 2026-10-15 did not return this id for the installed lodash versions (4.17.21, 4.18.1).
advisories.fix_path: No action required for the shipped trees. Lodash 4.17.23 or later addresses the active lodash _.template advisories already tracked (GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc).

withdraws.reason: BROWSER_SELF_DENIAL premise invalid: stored cross-user path exists via the sanitize_html is_json short-circuit at Frappe 988e54f3. Containment is unit-verified; runtime verification against a live bench is pending.
